svg.aria-label: Multifidus and rotatores (posterior view) — 多裂肌与回旋肌（后面观）

text.aria-label: Multifidus and rotatores (posterior view) — 多裂肌与回旋肌（后面观）
text.tspan: 多裂肌与回旋肌（后面观）

text.aria-label: Rotatores (drawn on the left side) — 回旋肌（画在左侧）
Multifidus (drawn on the right side) — 多裂肌（画在右侧）
Origin → insertion — 起点 → 止点
Origin: mammillary processes, sacrum and PSIS — 起点：乳突、骶骨和髂后上棘
text.tspan: Origin: mammillary processes, sacrum and PSIS
起点：乳突、骶骨和髂后上棘

text.aria-label: Insertion: spinous processes 2–5 levels above — 止点：上方 2–5 个节段的棘突
text.tspan: 止点：上方 2–5 个节段的棘突

text.aria-label: Origin: transverse process — 起点：横突
Insertion: lamina of the vertebra above — 止点：上一位椎骨的椎弓板
text.tspan: Insertion: lamina of the vertebra above
止点：上一位椎骨的椎弓板

text.aria-label: Both muscles are paired; each is drawn on one side only. — 两块肌肉都是左右成对的，图中各只画一侧。
text.tspan: Both muscles are paired; each is drawn on one side only.
两块肌肉都是左右成对的，图中各只画一侧。

text.aria-label: Lumbar rotatores are often inconsistent; deep multifidus fibres may replace them. — 腰部回旋肌常不恒定，可被多裂肌深层纤维取代。
text.tspan: Lumbar rotatores are often inconsistent; deep multifidus fibres may replace them.
腰部回旋肌常不恒定，可被多裂肌深层纤维取代。
Schematic; pathway and layers are simplified.
解剖示意；走行与层次经过简化。
